configuration.apiUrl.description: URL of an external OpenCode API server. Leave empty to auto-start a local instance.
configuration.opencodeBinary.description: Optional absolute path to the opencode CLI binary. Useful if PATH lookup fails. Requires window reload or API restart to apply.
configuration.fork.autoApprove.enabled.d: Enable scoped auto-approval for eligible permission requests. Disabled by default.
configuration.fork.autoApprove.timeoutSe: Seconds to show the auto-approval countdown before approving an eligible request.
configuration.fork.autoApprove.allowedTo: Tool names that may be auto-approved when all other policy checks pass.
configuration.fork.docs.requiredOnCodeCh: Require a docs-update decision when code changes are detected.
configuration.fork.modelFallback.enabled: Enable fallback chains for safe idempotent generation tasks.
configuration.fork.modelFallback.chain.d: Fallback model chain configuration for commit, PR, autocomplete, docs, and chat generation.
configuration.fork.repoIndex.enabled.des: Enable the project repository index used by autocomplete, context, and docs coverage.
Enable inline code autocomplete suggestions in the VS Code editor.
configuration.fork.commitGeneration.maxF: Maximum staged file paths sent to commit-message generation. Extra files are omitted from the generation prompt and reported in the UI.
configuration.fork.commitGeneration.vari: Show one-click commit-message variants after generation.
